context.description: kubeconfig context name; empty means the current context.

gitlab.description: The GitLab names of this environment, to find the release running in it (releases.yaml). Without it, the commit is only guessed from the image tag.

environment.description: GitLab environment the pipelines deploy to, e.g. prd. {repo} and {workload} are replaced by the repository and workload names.

job.description: Job whose log prints the digest of the image it deploys, e.g. promote-prd. {repo} and {workload} are replaced by the repository and workload names.

namespace_from.description: Read the namespace from a sops-encrypted dotenv file instead: sops:<file>#<key>.

namespaces.description: Namespaces holding the environment's workloads. Set this or namespace_from.

environments.description: Environments by name (lower-case letters, digits, '-'), in the order the environment picker shows them.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.
